CrowdChoreo

A 3D Skeleton Dataset for Group Dance

3D skeletons · Temporal action descriptions · Emotion · Formation

PipelineExplore examplesGitHub

CrowdChoreo is a 3D skeleton dataset for group dance, with temporal action descriptions, emotion labels, and formation annotations.

The dataset release contains skeleton data only. RGB clips on this page are provided solely as visual references.

These examples support qualitative inspection of RGB–motion correspondence. Skeletons use independent orthographic projections rather than calibrated RGB overlays. Emotion labels retain their model confidence; formations are derived from ground-plane geometry.
